coordinate_convention: original source pixels; x right, y down; polyline samples have no exact material vertex or cross-camera point correspondence
annotation_method: Independent visual review of all four original video views at seven times. Physical pink-silicone/gray-support perimeter corridors were manually selected and cross-checked against a local smoothed colour transition. No projected model, fitted camera overlay, or generated CAD edge was used to place observations.

boundary_convention.negative_y_outer_perimeter: The outer pad side adjacent to the negative-Y/exterior bank of wound1; appears left or upper-left in PSM1, right in PSM2. Fit against the actual preserved mesh silhouette of that side, not an assumed z=0 rectangle.

uncertainty_note: Conservative annotation scales in native pixels; not estimated statistical standard deviations. Rounded edge height, slight tissue deformation, optical blur and imperfect lens calibration may add systematic disagreement.
observability_limits: Only one physical pad side is reliably visible in these close-up videos. The opposite edge, total pad rectangle and all corners are unobserved.
Both endoscope views show pad interior through a vignette. Their dark image arcs are not pad-boundary observations.
Do not extrapolate across tools, lens vignette or crop boundaries, or turn shadows into silhouette constraints.
This side supports global alignment/scale checks jointly with wound shape, but cannot by itself validate every pad corner or independent metric scale.
Original native mesh geometry and region membership must remain unchanged.
